lines.新增诅咒系列植物，种植后会在关卡内带来负面效果。: Added Evil Plants. Planting them applies negative effects during the level.
lines.未来的更新中，会推出诅咒商店，为那些勇于挑战诅咒之人提供奖励: A shop is planned for a future update, with rewards for players who take on these challenges.
lines.优化调整了关卡流程，现在关卡结算时可获得诸神币: Adjusted level progression. Completing a level now awards 诸神币.
lines.新增诸神图鉴，可查阅植物进化路线与词条介绍，并可消耗诸神币解锁相关内容: Added The Gods Almanac. Browse plant evolution paths and modifier descriptions, and spend 诸神币 to unlock content.
lines.若曾通关过诸神进化，本版本会获得2000诸神币: If you previously completed The Gods: Evolved, this version grants you 2000 诸神币.
lines.·超级随机：刮刮乐（在推荐关卡处进入）: - Odyssey Gacha: Scratch Off! (access from Recommended Levels)
lines.·小松炉：基础冷却增加。高热小松炉持续时间延长，利于降低关卡内操作量: - @plant:35@: Increased base cooldown. 高热小松炉 lasts longer, reducing repeated actions during a level.
lines.·超级魅惑菇&究极魅惑菇：下调子弹伤害提升攻速: - @plant:1026@ and @plant:924@: Reduced projectile damage and increased attack speed.
lines.·毁灭水草：爆炸后不会留下毁灭睡莲: - @plant:1414@: No longer leaves 毁灭睡莲 behind after exploding.
lines.·连携词条：星神合一、星月护符重做: - Synergy Modifiers: Reworked 星神合一 and 星月护符.
lines.·究极五叶草：可以享受原种词条的加成: - @plant:920@: Now benefits from the modifiers of its original form.
lines.·究极Z教授：增强了其持续作战带来的威胁: - @zombie:223@: Becomes more threatening during prolonged combat.
lines.·优化 了词条图鉴的描述和标识: - Improved modifier descriptions and labels in the Almanac.
lines.9. 修复了一些已知的bug，优化了游戏体验: 9. Fixed known bugs and improved the gameplay experience.
lines.修复了魅惑僵尸能受到僵尸方攻击力加成的bug: Fixed a bug that allowed hypnotized zombies to receive enemy attack bonuses.
